blind.observation: AQM broadens Genesys quality scoring, Jev supplies answers and humans can challenge transparent scores.

Useful disagreement is the hook: resolution guidance looks clear to AI but timeline was not agreed. Broader visibility beyond manual sampling has value. Cost is explicitly input-only. Working prototype/fictional preview set expectations.

Jev makes typed quality judgments, AQM deterministically scores agreed versioned criteria; independent humans preserve original AI and create calibration evidence. Pilot is narrow queue/lead/form, representative conversations and measured coverage/cost/reviewer effort. Define-quality is densest; critical criteria plus weights need presenter explanation. No hidden secondary action needed for main story.

Define quality
What does good mean?

Quality is defined explicitly. AI doesn’t invent the scoring model.

Resolution & ownership · Published version 3

Acknowledged the impact

Did the agent acknowledge the customer’s difficulty?

Yes / No

Issue resolved

Was the customer’s stated issue resolved?

Yes / No

Clear next step

Was a specific next step and realistic timeline agreed?

Clear next step / Timeline not agreed

Action and timeline must be agreed. Clear earns 100% credit; missing timeline earns 0%. This criterion has double weight within Resolution and is critical: a failure means the form fails.

Customer care contributes one third of the score; Resolution contributes two thirds. The pass threshold is 75%.

If the issue is unresolved, an additional question asks who owns the escalation. It does not apply to Jamie’s resolved access issue.

Reuse agreed standards

Reusable question groups and answer sets keep common standards consistent across forms. Each published form keeps its own versioned snapshot.

Broader coverage becomes attractive

Structured, batched questions and Jev’s very low model input cost make broader evaluation economically attractive.

In this example, a policy selects 24 of 48 eligible conversations (50%) from one customer-service queue. Each uses the same published form. Conditional questions need another request only when they apply.

The calculator on Welcome lets you change volume, selection and request assumptions. Model cost is one component of a pilot’s operating cost.

MANAGEMENT INSIGHT
Resolution guidance needs attention

24 evaluations matched the same quality question; 5 showed weak next-step guidance. In the one completed human review, the reviewer challenged one AI judgment.

Investigate missing timelines, coach clear commitments, and refine the criterion with reviewers. These example counts illustrate a management decision, not population statistics.
